title: Continue one living Report through optimization outcomes
description:
As an account operator, I want the existing portfolio Report to continue through approved optimization and terminal review, so that selection, execution, evidence, and decisions remain available at one stable URL.

Feature: Phase-two living optimization Report

Scenario: Publish meaningful optimizer milestones
  Given a portfolio Report already contains frozen selection evidence
  When approvals, child launches, child state changes, reviews, or terminal outcomes occur
  Then the same Report is revised
  And earlier selection evidence remains available
  And revisions are not published for routine heartbeats

Scenario: Present score-level lifecycle
  Given a selected score progresses through diagnosis, approval, optimization, evaluation, and review
  When an operator expands that score
  Then its timeline and linked Procedure, Evaluation, ScoreVersion, Task, and artifacts are visible
  And the workbook and scorecard exports reconcile with the Report

Scenario: Request promotion without mutating the champion
  Given terminal evidence supports promotion readiness
  When the review completes
  Then an evidence-bound human approval request is created
  And no champion is changed automatically

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Wave 4 product and technical acceptance complete: deterministic score outcomes, contradictions, cross-artifact reconciliation, and dashboard presentation passed focused Python 3.11/3.12 and dashboard validation with independent review. Next gate is a model-backed existing-sandbox acceptance of the same Report through ChatMessage approval, exactly-once child dispatch, durable parent wait/resume, terminal review, and promotion-readiness request. No deployment or production mutation is authorized.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Validation update: local implementation and integration gates are green. Plexus Python 3.11 and 3.12 each completed with 4,300 passed, 41 skipped, and 3 expected failures; dispatch regressions passed on both versions. Dashboard typecheck, focused tests, full Jest, Storybook build, and Chromium suites passed. Final deterministic browser acceptance verified lifecycle reconciliation, contradictions, optimizer outcomes, policy/rank/cooldown context, progressive disclosure, and independent scorecard expansion. Tactus unit, behavior, standard-library, external-child, formatting, and lint gates passed. Amplify resource-definition diff remains zero. Cloud acceptance remains blocked because the approved sandbox lacks the complete asynchronous dispatcher and worker path; no endpoint was repointed and no infrastructure was provisioned. A final independent UI re-review is pending because the agent host reached its thread limit; preserve this review packet for the next fresh team session. No commit, push, deploy, optimizer launch, or production mutation was performed.
